text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 406, October 13, 1960 ]
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 113, SERIES OF 1955, ESTABLISHING THE
CLASSIFICATION OF ROADS
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, CARLOS P. GARCIA, President of the Philippines, do hereby
amend Executive Order No. 113, series of 1955, by declaring Katipunan Avenue (38-M Highway), Quezon
City, from Santolan Road, Km. 10.898 to Central Boulevard, Km. 12.089 a distance of 1,191 kilometers as
national secondary road.
Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and sixty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifteenth.
(SGD.) CARLOS P. GARCIA
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) NATALIO P. CASTILLO
Executive Secretary
